source='''from collections import Counter


def _components(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < height and 0 <= xx < width
                            and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            components.append((color, cells))
    return components


def _l_shape(cells):
    rows = [r for r, _ in cells]
    cols = [c for _, c in cells]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
    if len(cells) != (r1 - r0 + 1) + (c1 - c0 + 1) - 1:
        return None
    for er in (r0, r1):
        for ec in (c0, c1):
            if ((er, ec) in cells
                    and all((er, c) in cells for c in range(c0, c1 + 1))
                    and all((r, ec) in cells for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
                return er, ec
    return None


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    components = _components(grid)
    markers = []
    for color, cells in components:
        rows = [r for r, _ in cells]
        cols = [c for _, c in cells]
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
        if r1 - r0 + 1 < 3 or c1 - c0 + 1 < 3:
            continue
        elbow = _l_shape(cells)
        if elbow is not None:
            markers.append((color, cells, elbow, (r0, r1, c0, c1)))

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, marker, (er, ec), (r0, r1, c0, c1) in markers:
        horizontal_right = ec == c0
        vertical_down = er == r0
        candidates = []
        for other_color, cells in components:
            if cells == marker or len(cells) < 2:
                continue
            in_target_quadrant = any(
                (c <= ec if horizontal_right else c >= ec)
                and (r >= er if vertical_down else r <= er)
                for r, c in cells
            )
            if not in_target_quadrant:
                continue
            edges_touched = sum((
                any(r == 0 for r, _ in cells),
                any(r == height - 1 for r, _ in cells),
                any(c == 0 for _, c in cells),
                any(c == width - 1 for _, c in cells),
            ))
            if edges_touched >= 2:
                continue

            rows = [r for r, _ in cells]
            cols = [c for _, c in cells]
            object_elbow = _l_shape(cells)
            is_l = object_elbow is not None
            same_orientation = False
            if is_l:
                object_r0, object_c0 = min(rows), min(cols)
                same_orientation = (
                    (object_elbow[1] == object_c0) == horizontal_right
                    and (object_elbow[0] == object_r0) == vertical_down
                )
            distance = min(abs(r - er) + abs(c - ec) for r, c in cells)
            score = (
                0 if same_orientation else (1 if is_l else 2),
                -(max(rows) - min(rows) + 1 if is_l else len(cells)),
                distance,
            )
            candidates.append((score, cells))

        if candidates:
            _, target = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item[0])
            for r, c in target:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
